data.name: Muzaffar
data.gender_notes: Muzaffar is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Muzaffar is a name that symbolizes triumph and victory. It is a title given to a person who achieves great success and is recognized for their bravery and strength. In Islamic tradition, the name Muzaffar is associated with the qualities of a true Muslim, who strives to be victorious in their faith and deeds. The name Muzaffar carries the meaning “Triumphant, Victorious” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Muzaffar usually hope their child will grow to embody triumphant, victorious and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.etymology: Muzaffar belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Triumphant, Victorious.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Muzaffar total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

in_arabic.name: منزفر
in_arabic.long_meaning: منزفر هو اسم علم مذكر عربي، ويأتي من الجذر (ن-ز-ف) في اللغة العربية، ويُعنى بالفوز المبارك والمُغلبة للمُؤمنين. ويُستخدم في القرآن الكريم في سورة المجادلة: (وَإِن جَنَحُوا لِلسَّمْعِ فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ لَمُسمِعٌ حَنيفٌ) (المجادلة: 23)، ويُعد اسمًا مشروعًا في الإسلام، حيث يُرمز إلى النصر والمُغلبة على الأعداء.

in_urdu.name: منزفر
in_urdu.meaning: فلاح و کامیابی کا نام ہے
in_urdu.long_meaning: منزفر ایک مذکر اسم علم ہے جو عرب زبان سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے کامیابی اور فلاح۔ یہ نام قرآن کے سورة المجادله میں آیا ہے جس میں اللہ تعالیٰ کی قدرت پر اشارہ ہے جس کی آگہی ہوتی ہے اور سچا رستہ دکھاتی ہے۔

in_hindi.name: मनजफर

data.cultural_impact: The name Muzaffar holds significant cultural importance due to its Arabic roots and its association with Islamic history and tradition. Historically, the name was given to victorious leaders and warriors, denoting their triumph over their enemies and their successful rule over their lands. In contemporary times, the name continues to be used as a title of honor and respect, often given to individuals who have achieved great success or have displayed outstanding bravery and strength.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Muzaffar carries a deeper meaning. It is a reminder of the ultimate goal for every Muslim - to strive for success and victory in their faith and deeds. The Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) encouraged his followers to be victorious over their nafs (ego), desires, and passions, and to seek victory in the Hereafter by leading a righteous and obedient life. By following this guidance, a Muzaffar can achieve true triumph and victory, not just in this world, but in the next.
